relationships.subject: urinary NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Neuropathic pain score was significantly associated with higher NGF levels, and this relationship remained significant after controlling for age, BMI, and urinary urgency

key_findings: In women with urgency without incontinence, bladder pain was associated with higher urinary VEGF and osteopontin; neuropathic pain scores with higher urinary NGF.
Urgency associations with NGF and BDNF did not persist after adjusting for age and BMI.
